questions.en: In which Middle Eastern city does the 828-metre-tall Burj Khalifa, with its 160 storeys, rise?

timeline.labelEn: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai, the world's tallest building, is officially opened

questions.de: Wer komponierte das Lied, das Schlagerstar Jürgen Drews als Ein Bett im Kornfeld sang?
questions.en: Who composed the song that Schlager star Jürgen Drews sang as Ein Bett im Kornfeld?

timeline.labelEn: Jürgen Drews releases Ein Bett im Kornfeld, a German version of Let Your Love Flow
timeline.labelDe: Jürgen Drews veröffentlicht Ein Bett im Kornfeld, eine deutsche Version von Let Your Love Flow

questions.notes: Card's statement is false: the song is a cover of the Bellamy Brothers' Let Your Love Flow (1976), written by Larry E. Williams (de.wikipedia names him Jerry Williams jr.); German lyrics by Michael Kunze.

questions.cardDe: Aus was wurde in der DDR der Marzipanersatz Nakapan hergestellt: Kartoffeln, Kohlrüben oder Kohlrabi?
questions.de: Aus welchem Grundstoff wurde in der DDR der Marzipanersatz Nakapan hergestellt?
questions.en: From what basic ingredient was the marzipan substitute Nakapan made in the GDR?

timeline.labelEn: The German Democratic Republic, where marzipan substitutes such as Resipan and Nakapan were made
timeline.labelDe: Die DDR, in der Marzipanersatz wie Resipan und Nakapan hergestellt wurde

questions.notes: Reworked from multiple choice. Nakapan used potato semolina (Kartoffelgrieß) with sugar and flavouring instead of Resipan's maize semolina; accept 'Kartoffelgrieß'. No date for Nakapan itself was found, so the timeline is the GDR.

source.title: Bokwa fitness: easy as A-B-C, 1-2-3 – The Philadelphia Inquirer

questions.notes: Reworked from multiple choice (answer: you move to it). The Inquirer (June 2013) says Bokwa launched in the UK about two years earlier; name from boxing + kwaito.
